title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

series.title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

fullText.simplified:
第十八章、小山之死

    牛村的王铁告诉包拯，高小山因为放了一个宫女和一个太监出宫，所以被张怀抓走了。
    “你知道后来发生了什么吗？”包拯关心地问。
    王铁悲伤地说：“张怀把他抓走了，十多分钟后，小山就死了。张怀杀了小山，还把他从城墙上推下来，告诉大家小山是不小心摔死的。”
    “这些事情，你是怎么知道的？”包拯问。
    “都是我亲眼看到的。当时我也被叫去救火，但我忘记拿桶了，回来拿桶时看到小山和那个宫女、太监了。我不知道他们对小山说了什么，但当时他们的样子确实非常可怜。小山放他们走后，张怀来侍卫营找人，我对小山说别承认，但他还是站了出来。他被张怀带走的时候，我跟在后面，亲眼看到张怀向小山问话，然后生气大怒，一刀杀了小山。”
    “张怀问高小山什么？”
    “当时我害怕被发现，离得比较远，听得不太清楚，好像是问那名宫女和太监去哪儿了，但小山一直摇头说不知道。”
    “你看清那名宫女和太监了吗？”
    “当时是夜里十一点多，天很黑，我离得比较远，只远远看到他们和小山说话。他们年纪都很小，太监抱着个盒子跪在地上一直哭，宫女沉着一些，但是……”
    “盒子？什么盒子？”
    “黑色的，有提手，挺大的，有点像装点心用的食盒。”
    “食盒？”包拯和公孙策同时震惊地叫出了声。
    王铁被他们的反应吓了一跳，不知所措地问：“食盒怎么了？有什么不对吗？”
    “你认识那名宫女和太监吗？他们是李妃宫里的人吗？宫女的名字是不是叫楚珠？”包拯连声问道。
    这一次换王铁震惊了，他不敢相信地问：“您怎么知道？”
    “太监呢？太监你也认识吗？”
    “太监叫马超，他是刘妃宫里的，我以前在刘妃宫里见过他。”
    “刘妃宫里的？”包拯疑惑了。
    王铁点头说：“是啊，当时我没多想，后来再想一想，也觉得奇怪，为什么那晚李妃宫里的宫女会和刘妃宫里的太监在一起呢？”
    “你知道他们为什么出宫吗？张怀为什么要找他们？”
    “这个我就不知道了。当时我问过小山，为什么放他们出宫，小山却不愿意告诉我，还说我不知道是好事。我不懂他的意思，当时急着去救火，就没多问。现在想一想，应该是和冷宫的李妃有关，所以张怀才要找他们。”
fullText.traditional:
第十八章、小山之死

    牛村的王鐵告訴包拯，高小山因為放了一個宮女和一個太監出宮，所以被張懷抓走了。
    “你知道後來發生了什麼嗎？”包拯關心地問。
    王鐵悲傷地說：“張懷把他抓走了，十多分鐘後，小山就死了。張懷殺了小山，還把他從城牆上推下來，告訴大家小山是不小心摔死的。”
    “這些事情，你是怎麼知道的？”包拯問。
    “都是我親眼看到的。當時我也被叫去救火，但我忘記拿桶了，回來拿桶時看到小山和那個宮女、太監了。我不知道他們對小山說了什麼，但當時他們的樣子確實非常可憐。小山放他們走後，張懷來侍衛營找人，我對小山說別承認，但他還是站了出來。他被張懷帶走的時候，我跟在後面，親眼看到張懷向小山問話，然後生氣大怒，一刀殺了小山。”
    “張懷問高小山什麼？”
    “當時我害怕被發現，離得比較遠，聽得不太清楚，好像是問那名宮女和太監去哪兒了，但小山一直搖頭說不知道。”
    “你看清那名宮女和太監了嗎？”
    “當時是夜裡十一點多，天很黑，我離得比較遠，只遠遠看到他們和小山說話。他們年紀都很小，太監抱著個盒子跪在地上一直哭，宮女沉著一些，但是……”
    “盒子？什麼盒子？”
    “黑色的，有提手，挺大的，有點像裝點心用的食盒。”
    “食盒？”包拯和公孫策同時震驚地叫出了聲。
    王鐵被他們的反應嚇了一跳，不知所措地問：“食盒怎麼了？有什麼不對嗎？”
    “你認識那名宮女和太監嗎？他們是李妃宮裡的人嗎？宮女的名字是不是叫楚珠？”包拯連聲問道。
    這一次換王鐵震驚了，他不敢相信地問：“您怎麼知道？”
    “太監呢？太監你也認識嗎？”
    “太監叫馬超，他是劉妃宮裡的，我以前在劉妃宮裡見過他。”
    “劉妃宮裡的？”包拯疑惑了。
    王鐵點頭說：“是啊，當時我沒多想，後來再想一想，也覺得奇怪，為什麼那晚李妃宮裡的宮女會和劉妃宮裡的太監在一起呢？”
    “你知道他們為什麼出宮嗎？張懷為什麼要找他們？”
    “這個我就不知道了。當時我問過小山，為什麼放他們出宮，小山卻不願意告訴我，還說我不知道是好事。我不懂他的意思，當時急著去救火，就沒多問。現在想一想，應該是和冷宮的李妃有關，所以張懷才要找他們。”

sentences.english: “Do you know why they left the palace? Why did Zhang Huai want to find them?”

sentences.simplified: “这个我就不知道了。
sentences.traditional: “這個我就不知道了。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge wǒ jiù bù zhī dào le
sentences.english: “I don’t know about that.

sentences.simplified: 当时我问过小山，为什么放他们出宫，
sentences.traditional: 當時我問過小山，為什麼放他們出宮，
sentences.pinyin: dāng shí wǒ wèn guò xiǎo shān wèi shén me fàng tā men chū gōng
sentences.english: At that time, I asked Xiaoshan why he let them out of the palace, ..

sentences.simplified: 小山却不愿意告诉我，还说我不知道是好事。
sentences.traditional: 小山卻不願意告訴我，還說我不知道是好事。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎo shān què bú yuàn yì gào su wǒ hái shuō wǒ bù zhī dào shì hǎo shì
sentences.english: .. but Xiaoshan was unwilling to tell me and said that it would be better if I didn’t know.

sentences.simplified: 我不懂他的意思，当时急着去救火，就没多问。
sentences.traditional: 我不懂他的意思，當時急著去救火，就沒多問。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ bù dǒng tā de yì si dāng shí jí zhe qù jiù huǒ jiù méi duō wèn
sentences.english: I didn’t understand what he meant. I was in a hurry to put out the fire at the time, so I didn’t ask further.

sentences.simplified: 现在想一想，应该是和冷宫的李妃有关，所以张怀才要找他们。”
sentences.traditional: 現在想一想，應該是和冷宮的李妃有關，所以張懷才要找他們。”
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài xiǎng yì xiǎng yīng gāi shì hé lěng gōng de lǐ fēi yǒu guān suǒ yǐ zhāng huái cái yào zhǎo tā men
sentences.english: Now thinking about it, it must have to do with Consort Li from the Cold Palace. That must be why Zhang Huai wanted to find them.”

sentence_translations: Chapter 18: The Death of Xiaoshan
Wang Tie from Niu Village told Bao Zheng, ..
.. that Gao Xiaoshan was arrested by Zhang Huai because he let a palace maid and a eunuch leave the palace.
“Do you know what happened afterwards?” Bao Zheng asked with concern.
Wang Tie said sadly, “Zhang Huai took him away, and Xiaoshan was dead about ten minutes later.
Zhang Huai killed Xiaoshan. He pushed him off the city wall and told everyone that Xiaoshan died accidentally from a fall.”
“How do you know about these things?” Bao Zheng asked.
“I saw it all with my own eyes.
At that time, I was also called to put out the fire, but I forgot to bring a bucket.
When I came back to get a bucket, I saw Xiaoshan, the palace maid, and the eunuch.
I don’t know what they said to Xiaoshan, but at that time, they certainly looked very pitiful.
After Xiaoshan let them go, Zhang Huai came looking for them at the imperial guard camp.
I told Xiaoshan not to admit it, but he still stood up.
When he was taken away by Zhang Huai, I followed behind and saw with my own eyes Zhang Huai questioning Xiaoshan, ..
.. then becoming angry and killing Xiaoshan with a single stroke of his knife.”
“What did Zhang Huai ask Gao Xiaoshan?”
“At that time, I was afraid of being discovered, so I kept my distance and couldn’t hear very clearly.
It seemed like they were asking where the palace maid and the eunuch had gone, ..
.. but Xiaoshan kept shaking his head, saying he didn’t know.”
“Did you see that palace maid and eunuch clearly?”
“It was past eleven o’clock at night, the sky was very dark, and I was quite far away.
I could only see them talking to Xiaoshan from a distance.
They were both very young. The eunuch, holding a box, knelt on the ground and kept crying.
The palace maid was a bit calmer, but …”
“Box? What box?”
“Black, with a handle, quite large, somewhat like a food box used for holding pastries.”
“Food box?” Bao Zheng and Gongsun Ce exclaimed in shock simultaneously.
Wang Tie was startled by their reaction and asked at a complete loss, “What about the food box? Is there something wrong?”
“Did you recognize that palace maid and eunuch? Were they from Consort Li’s palace?
Was the palace maid’s name Chu Zhu?” Bao Zheng asked repeatedly.
This time, it was Wang Tie who was shocked. He asked in disbelief, “How did you know?”
“What about the eunuch? Did you also recognize the eunuch?”
“The eunuch’s name was Ma Chao. He was from Consort Liu’s palace. I had seen him before in Consort Liu’s palace.”
“In Consort Liu’s palace?” Bao Zheng was puzzled.
Wang Tie nodded and said, “Yes, I didn’t think much about it at the time, but when I thought about it again later, I found it strange.
Why would a palace maid from Consort Li’s palace be with an eunuch from Consort Liu’s palace that night?”
“Do you know why they left the palace? Why did Zhang Huai want to find them?”
“I don’t know about that.
At that time, I asked Xiaoshan why he let them out of the palace, ..
.. but Xiaoshan was unwilling to tell me and said that it would be better if I didn’t know.
I didn’t understand what he meant. I was in a hurry to put out the fire at the time, so I didn’t ask further.
Now thinking about it, it must have to do with Consort Li from the Cold Palace. That must be why Zhang Huai wanted to find them.”
